segments.label: High health need with weak access
segments.hypothesis: Responses should show unmet need, access barriers, and irregular checkups.

segments.label: Relatively healthy with weak access or low urgency
segments.hypothesis: They should postpone preventive care because it feels less urgent despite access constraints.

segments.label: Healthy and adequately insured preventive users
segments.hypothesis: They should schedule more regularly and express stronger preventive-care beliefs.

segments.label: Older adults with meaningful health needs
segments.hypothesis: They should report higher clinical need but greater scheduling and preparation friction.
